mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO settle_file_task ( task_no, settle_date, member_id, file_type, version, status, retry_count, max_retry_count ) VALUES ( #{taskNo}, #{settleDate}, #{memberId}, #{fileType}, #{version}, #{status}, 0, 3 )
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_no, settle_date, member_id, file_type, version, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, last_message_id, last_send_time, last_consume_time, error_message, start_time, end_time, created_at, updated_at FROM settle_file_task WHERE task_no = #{taskNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE settle_file_task SET status = 'GENERATING', error_message = NULL, start_time = NOW(), end_time = NULL, last_consume_time = NOW() WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND status IN ('INIT', 'SENT', 'FAILED')
UPDATE settle_file_task SET status = 'GENERATED', end_time = NOW(), error_message = NULL WHERE task_no = #{taskNo}

UPDATE settle_file_task SET status = 'SENT', last_message_id = #{messageId}, last_send_time = NOW(), error_message = NULL WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND status IN ('INIT', 'SENT', 'FAILED', 'SEND_FAILED')

UPDATE settle_file_task
status = #{toStatus},
error_message = NULL, start_time = NOW(), end_time = NULL, last_consume_time = NOW(),
end_time = NOW(), error_message = NULL,
end_time = NOW(), retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_message = #{errorMessage},
WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE settle_file_task SET status = 'FAILED', end_time = NOW(), error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE status = 'GENERATING' AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE)
